basics.name: Alex Morgan
basics.title: Platform Engineer | Python · Linux · Developer Tools

summary: Platform engineer building reliable delivery systems and internal developer tools. Experienced in Python automation, Linux operations, CI pipelines and service observability. This resume is fictional demonstration data, not a real candidate profile.

experience.scope: Fictional example: support delivery tooling and infrastructure for a small engineering team.
bullets: **Built a Python release service** for 6 applications, replacing manual version selection with validated deployment inputs and a recorded release history.
**Standardized CI checks across 8 repositories**, integrating unit tests and linting with merge-request status reporting so reviewers could inspect failures before merging.
**Automated Linux provisioning for 40 hosts** using reusable Ansible roles, reducing repetitive setup and documenting the configuration for future maintenance.
**Created service-health dashboards** covering 12 services and added alerts with troubleshooting links to help engineers investigate failures.
**Mentored 2 engineers** on pipeline maintenance and rollback exercises, using documented scenarios to practice recovery before production releases.

projects.name: Release Readiness Dashboard
projects.desc: Built a fictional internal dashboard combining build status and release metadata into a reviewable checklist. Added tests for missing and inconsistent deployment inputs.
